messages:
Alex (Collections): Quick heads-up: NimbusAI (acct NA-113) is overdue on invoice 2026-06-08 for $12,300. They emailed asking to convert to a 3-month installment plan and asked we waive the 1.5% late fee.
Rina (Finance): Small amount but recurring pattern. Do we have card on file?
Omar (Acct Exec): They used ACH in the past, no card. CFO says cashflow tight due to delayed receivables. They offered a signed promissory.
Tess (Customer Success): I checked their recent traffic; nothing anomalous. No technical dispute.
Alex (Collections): My thinking: offer 30% upfront within 5 business days, then two equal installments over next 60 days. Waive the late fee only if the first installment arrives on time and they sign payment agreement. Also require ACH trace/confirmation.
Rina (Finance): Agree. Add a 1% processing fee for split payments. Keep the 1.5% monthly finance charge for missed payments. CC billing@redwood.
legal-bot: Contract allows suspension after 30 days. Approve wording: "temporary suspension of Dedicated capacity and API keys" if payments missed.
Omar (Acct Exec): I'll call their AR team if you send the message.
Alex (Collections): Draft reply below, quick review?
Alex (Collections): ```Hi NimbusAI team, thanks for reaching out. We can offer a one-time payment plan for invoice 2026-06-08 ($12,300): 30% due within five (5) business days, with the remaining balance split into two equal installments over the following 60 days. Please sign the attached payment agreement and provide an ACH trace or wire confirmation for the initial payment. We will waive the late fee for this invoice only if the first installment is received on time. Split payments will incur a 1% processing fee; missed payments are subject to a 1.5% monthly finance charge and may result in temporary suspension of Dedicated capacity and API keys. Please confirm acceptance and payment method so we can finalize the agreement. \n-- Alex, Redwood Billing```
Rina (Finance): Looks good. Add CC to billing@redwood and require CFO email confirmation if they request longer terms.
Omar (Acct Exec): I'll call and push for ACH within 48h.
Tess (Customer Success): I'll attach the short traffic note so they know there's no technical dispute.
Alex (Collections): Sending now with edits and CCs. If no reply by follow-up (1805506400) we'll escalate to dunning step 2.
